environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28, pod deployed in namespace 'data-processing' with Istio 1.20.2 sidecar. Mesh-wide PeerAuthentication set to STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy resource in namespace 'data-processing' specifies: spec.rules with 'from' source.namespaces=['data-processing'] and source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/data-processing/sa/*'. The policy action is ALLOW with no additional rules, meaning any request originating from a principal NOT in the data-processing namespace is implicitly denied by Istio's authorization engine (deny-by-default when an ALLOW policy exists). Cross-namespace traffic from 'default', 'monitoring', or any attacker-controlled namespace is rejected at the Envoy proxy layer before reaching the application container on port 50051.
